invariants: Preview alone never creates ContextAttachment or calls the model
Pin shows chip with title/version/range; removable before send
Send freezes ResourceRef revision; later file edits do not silently refresh the pin
When workspace digest diverges, UI tips old revision and offers explicit refresh
Server verify_attachments marks stale/missing without swapping pinned digest
Excerpt via resources/read is bounded; truncated excerpts must be labeled
origin is user|auto; auto retrieval is separate from user pin priority

routes.purpose: Verify ContextAttachment pins vs live digests
